$comment: The clean control doing its job. Seven risks against a feature whose genuine risk set is small, and four
of the seven are risks the epic rules out in as many words: exposure of data the holder can already see,
corruption by a read-only read, a render cost on a screen that is already open, and an unrecoverable
rollout of a row that ships behind an existing flag.
It is in the corpus because recall alone rewards a system that reports everything, and without a control
this suite would be passed by a workflow that emits the same nine risks whatever it is handed. It is also
the only case that resolves all four clean-set oracles to false.
derivation: Seven risk rows, R-001 through R-007, so wellFormedIds is 7 and validCategories is 7 over SEC, DATA,
PERF, OPS, BUS, TECH and BUS.
Scale and arithmetic: 2x3=6, 2x3=6, 2x2=4, 2x2=4, 2x2=4, 2x1=2, 1x1=1. All in range and all correct, so
inScale is 7, the denominator is 7 and arithmeticOk is 7. Bands: the two sixes under Score >=6, the three
fours under Score 3-4, the 2 and the 1 under Score 1-2, so banded is 7 and bandOk is 7. The register is
well formed throughout, which is what makes the case worth storing: nothing about its shape is wrong.
Risk links: seven coverage rows each naming a declared id, so 7 of 7 resolve.
The clean set declares no material risk, so grounding is 0 of 0, coverage evaluates nothing and no
ordering pair exists.
Ungrounded: R-001 matches unauthorized-exposure, R-002 matches data-loss-or-corruption, R-003 matches
render-performance-degradation and R-004 matches rollout-without-kill-switch. R-005, R-006 and R-007
match nothing, which is correct: the drifted clock, the absent value and the unreviewed wording are real
questions about this feature and the epic rules out none of them.
Clean control: seven rows against a ceiling of three, so the excess is 4.
WHAT MOVED AT SCORER VERSION 5
`banded` is now `rows` on every case, because a row under a heading that declares no score range is a
band failure rather than an exemption. `cleanControl` is `ceiling` and both sets declare one, so the
seeded corpus is bounded too. `grounding` carries `topSeverityMissed`, the count of the set's
lowest-ranked risks that went unreported. Material risks are assigned by maximum matching rather than
first-come, and every row is tested against the exclusions whether or not it matched a material risk.
